```sh
paperworks create-docx --spec "$SKILL_DIR/examples/report.json" --output report.docx
paperworks inspect report.docx > before.json
paperworks create-docx --spec "$SKILL_DIR/examples/customer-template.json" --output customer-source.docx
cat > control.json <<'JSON'
{"operation":"control","marker":"{{NAME}}","tag":"customer"}
JSON
paperworks word-edit customer-source.docx --spec control.json --output template.docx
cat > fill.json <<'JSON'
{"operation":"control-fill","tag":"customer","text":"Example customer"}
JSON
paperworks word-edit template.docx --spec fill.json --output filled.docx
cat > contract.json <<'JSON'
{"allow_changed":["word/document.xml"]}
JSON
paperworks verify-preservation customer-source.docx --against filled.docx --requirements contract.json
paperworks inspect filled.docx > after.json
paperworks table-exchange filled.docx --table-index 0 --output table.csv
```

```sh
paperworks render filled.docx --output word-pages --max-pixels 1600
```
